ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice came down to capability matching. The query is a creative-writing request with no sensitive or harm-adjacent material, so the two models' differing aversion profiles (Lapwing/Dunlin's moderation tuning) don't apply here. With that factor neutral, I picked on raw capability: Dunlin leads on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) plus higher Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4) and IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), the metrics most relevant to producing a well-crafted, instruction-following scene.
